contrast_rule: Allocate 4 shared-funding, 3 CEX/infra, and 3 ordinary matched contrasts after excluding control membership; ties use neutral source_rank, mint, creator order.
minimum_detector_rule: A later operation candidate requires topology or funding context plus at least one independently sourced behaviour, migration actor, recurring-actor, or timing dimension. Shared funding, shared upstream lineage, or CEX/infra ancestry alone is insufficient.
positive_control_rule: Materialize the snapshot manifest first. Independently rank each control by locally retained non-label evidence completeness, then source_rank and mint; labels remain evaluation-only.
residual_budget_rule: Only unresolved selected-row gaps may receive a future request; caps are 24 migration, 12 topology, 8 behaviour, 44 total; retry=0, pagination=0, fallback=none.
s2b_preconditions: materialize and digest exact population membership
map evaluation truth via separate read-only join
emit exact identities before any residual target
